module SynchronousFSM_combined (
    input  clk,
    input  x,
    input  [2:0] y,
    output reg Y0,
    output reg z
);
    reg [2:0] Y, Y_next;
    always @(*) begin
        case ({y, x})
            6'b000000: begin Y_next = 3'b000; z = 1'b0; end
            6'b000001: begin Y_next = 3'b001; z = 1'b0; end
            6'b000010: begin Y_next = 3'b010; z = 1'b0; end
            6'b000011: begin Y_next = 3'b001; z = 1'b1; end
            6'b000100: begin Y_next = 3'b011; z = 1'b1; end
            default: begin Y_next = 3'b111; z = 1'bx; end
        endcase
        Y = oh2bin(Y_next);
        Y0 = (Y == 3'b000);
    end
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        Y <= Y_next;
    end
endmodule

// One-hot FSM state encoding
`define ST_0 3'b000
`define ST_1 3'b001
`define ST_2 3'b010
`define ST_3 3'b011
`define ST_4 3'b100

module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  x,
    input  [2:0] y,
    output reg Y0,
    output reg z
);
    reg [2:0] st, nxt_st;
    always @(*) begin
        case (st)
            `ST_0: begin Y0=1'b0; z=1'b0; nxt_st = (x ? `ST_1 : `ST_0); end
            `ST_1: begin Y0=1'b0; z=1'b0; nxt_st = (x ? `ST_4 : `ST_2); end
            `ST_2: begin Y0=1'b0; z=1'b0; nxt_st = (x ? `ST_3 : `ST_0); end
            `ST_3: begin Y0=1'b1; z=1'b1; nxt_st = (x ? `ST_4 : `ST_0); end
            `ST_4: begin Y0=1'b1; z=1'b1; nxt_st = (x ? `ST_1 : `ST_3); end
            default: begin Y0=1'b0; z=1'b0; nxt_st = 3'b000; end
        endcase
    end
    always @(posedge clk) st <= nxt_st;
    initial st <= `ST_0;
endmodule

module TopModule(input clk, input x, input [2:0] y, output reg Y0, output reg z);
  reg [2:0] state, nextstate;
  always @(*) begin
    case ({state, x})
      6'b000000: begin nextstate = 3'b000; Y0 = 1; z = 0; end
      6'b000001: begin nextstate = 3'b001; Y0 = 0; z = 0; end
      6'b000010: begin nextstate = 3'b010; Y0 = 0; z = 0; end
      6'b000011: begin nextstate = 3'b001; Y0 = 0; z = 1; end
      6'b000100: begin nextstate = 3'b011; Y0 = 1; z = 1; end
      6'b001000: begin nextstate = 3'b000; Y0 = 1; z = 0; end
      6'b001001: begin nextstate = 3'b001; Y0 = 0; z = 0; end
      6'b001010: begin nextstate = 3'b010; Y0 = 0; z = 0; end
      6'b001011: begin nextstate = 3'b001; Y0 = 0; z = 1; end
      6'b001100: begin nextstate = 3'b011; Y0 = 1; z = 1; end
      default:   begin nextstate = 3'bx; Y0 = 1'bx; z = 1'bx; end
    endcase
  end
  always @(posedge clk) state <= nextstate;
endmodule
